messages:
sam: Hey — PR #19456 is blocked, CI shows a nondeterministic timeout in integration/shard-9 (TestKVEvict). Buildkite shows 1/3 flakes, merge window in 45m. Can someone kick a targeted rerun or give a quick take?
ci-bot: buildkite: build 19456 #37 failed on shard-9: 
```
ERROR: TestKVEvict timed out after 120s
logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/19456/37
```
anya: I can trigger a targeted rerun in ~8m. want me to only rerun shard-9 or the whole matrix? :eyes:
jordan: shard-9 only is fine for now — saves queue. if it flakes again twice we should consider bisecting the test and adding a quarantine label.
maria: pinging owners: @nguyen any quick signal from the test logs about external deps?
nguyen: scanning logs now. I see repeated 503s from embed-index-service around the same timestamps as the timeouts. attaching a snippet:
```
embed-index-service | 2026-05-14T17:22:10Z | 503 GET /v1/index/lookup duration=45ms
```
nguyen: could be transient infra or a burst from that test harness. not a snapshot update.
sre-oncall: noticed high CPU on gpu-host-7 in pool-3 around those runs, correlated with a deploy 17:20. I'm migrating noisy pods off that host and will re-evaluate in 5m.
anya: ok kicked targeted rerun for shard-9: `./scripts/ci rerun --pr 19456 --shard 9` :thumbsup:
ci-bot: buildkite: rerun queued for shard-9 (build 19456 #38).
sam: thanks. if #38 passes we can merge; if it fails again let's hold and bisect. I'll update the PR description with the plan.
ci-bot: buildkite: build 19456 #38 succeeded on shard-9. all green.
sam: awesome — merging now. :tada: Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
jordan: noted: follow-up action to add a short flake check to the test's harness to reduce external call bursts. filed issue #4520.
maria: filing a post-merge watch to keep an eye for recurrence.
